policies.title: Annual & Paid Time Off Policy
policies.content: All full-time employees are entitled to 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per month. Unused leaves up to 10 days can be carried forward to the next year. Medical/Sick leave is 12 days per year, requiring a medical certificate if consecutive days exceed 3. Casual leave is 8 days per year.

policies.title: Remote & Hybrid Work Policy
policies.content: Employees in Engineering, Product, and Design may work remotely up to 3 days per week (typically Tuesday and Thursday in office, or manager-approved schedule). Fridays are company-wide optional remote days for eligible teams. Customer Support and Sales teams follow department-specific rotas. High-speed internet allowance of INR 2,000/month is reimbursed.
policies.approval_required: Department Head approval for permanent full-remote

policies.title: Parental & Maternity/Paternity Leave Policy
policies.content: Female employees are eligible for 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for up to two surviving children. Male employees are entitled to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave within 6 months of childbirth or adoption. Adoption leave of 12 weeks is provided for adopting a child below 1 year.
policies.approval_required: HR verification with supporting medical/legal documents

policies.title: Sabbatical & Long Leave Policy
policies.content: Employees with a minimum of 5 continuous years of tenure are eligible to apply for an unpaid or partially sponsored sabbatical leave of up to 3 months for higher education, research, or personal enrichment. Performance rating must be 'Exceeds Expectations' or 'Meets Expectations' in the last 2 evaluation cycles.

policies.title: Health & Wellness Benefits Policy
policies.content: Group Medical Insurance covers employees, spouse, up to 2 children, and dependent parents up to INR 7,00,000 sum insured. Annual health checkup is 100% reimbursed up to INR 3,500. Mental wellness subscriptions (Calm / Practo Mind) are fully subsidized by the company.

policies.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement Policy
policies.content: Official domestic travel permits flight bookings in Economy class for trips over 6 hours; AC 2-Tier train or Economy flights otherwise. Hotel stay limit is INR 4,500/night for Tier-1 cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru) and INR 3,000/night for Tier-2 cities. Per-diem food allowance is INR 1,200/day.
